member_stats.doc: Retrieve aggregated member statistics for the Admin Console header: total members, admins, pending invites, and external guests within the current domain organisation.

total_members.doc: Total non-system, non-archived members in the organisation

pending_invites.doc: Active members who have never connected (connected = 0)

external_guests.doc: Distinct DMZ guests who have accessed hubs belonging to this organisation

errors.message: No organisation found for the current domain

member_list_workspaces.doc: Retrieve the list of active workspaces (hubs) within the organisation that a specific member has access to.

user_id.doc: ID of the member whose workspace list to retrieve

returns.doc: List of workspace objects the member has access to within the organisation

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_device_list.doc: Retrieve the list of active registered security devices for a specific member.

user_id.doc: ID of the member whose device list to retrieve

returns.doc: List of active device records for the member, ordered by most recently active

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_device_remove.doc: Revoke a specific registered security device for a member by device record ID.

user_id.doc: ID of the member whose device to revoke

device_id.doc: sys_id of the device record to revoke

returns.doc: Result object with affected row count

affected.doc: Number of rows updated (1 if successful, 0 if device not found or already revoked)

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_device_remove_all.doc: Revoke all active registered security devices for a specific member.

user_id.doc: ID of the member whose devices to revoke

returns.doc: Result object with affected row count

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_set_workspace_admin.doc: Grant Workspace Admin permission (permission level 31) to a member on one or more specific hubs within the organisation. Only hubs belonging to the caller's organisation are processed.

user_id.doc: ID of the member to promote to Workspace Admin

hub_id.doc: Array of hub IDs to grant Workspace Admin access on. Accepts a single string which is normalised to an array.

returns.doc: List of results per hub, each containing hub_id and the updated permission record

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_remove_workspace_admin.doc: Downgrade a Workspace Admin back to regular member (permission level 7) on one or more specific hubs within the organisation. Only hubs belonging to the caller's organisation are processed.

user_id.doc: ID of the member to downgrade from Workspace Admin

hub_id.doc: Array of hub IDs to remove Workspace Admin access from. Accepts a single string which is normalised to an array.

returns.doc: Status object confirming the operation completed

errors.message: No organisation found or target user does not belong to the same organisation
Target user belongs to a different organisation

member_list_workspace_admins.doc: Retrieve the list of members who have Workspace Admin permission on at least one hub within the organisation.

returns.doc: List of member detail records for all workspace admins in the organisation

errors.message: No organisation found for the current domain
